criteria.description: Specific unambiguous OLD:/NEW: revisions bypass AI and preserve all non-target text.
criteria.source: implement the proposed deterministic exact-text patch path
criteria.verification: Apply multiple exact pairs with model sentinels and byte-compare all non-target content.

criteria.description: Repeated identical semantic revisions use a content-addressed cache and avoid a second model call.
criteria.verification: Run the same semantic revision twice and count model calls while checking cache metadata.

criteria.description: Cache identity changes with owner, source content, normalized instruction meaning, correction image, job/profile, or model settings.
criteria.source: baseline: cached personal CV output must not cross inputs or accounts
criteria.verification: Compare cache keys and invalidation behavior across each load-bearing input.

criteria.description: Ambiguous edits and correction images retain the existing AI path.
criteria.verification: Exercise missing, ambiguous, multiline, semantic, and image instructions against route sentinels.

criteria.description: Exact replacement compilation is atomic and owner-scoped.
criteria.source: baseline: optimization must not corrupt or expose current application artifacts
criteria.verification: Force compilation failure, compare original hashes, and test another account's endpoint.

criteria.description: Load-bearing timing, route, cache, and preservation claims are measured.
criteria.source: baseline: a claim that decides the verdict must be measured
criteria.verification: Review elapsed times, call counts, cache hits/keys, paths, and hashes.
